newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso gains 2.4 vs dollar by close.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso gains 2.4 vs dollar by close.

text.p: Colombia's peso gained 2.4 pesos to close at 1,058.8 against the greenback amid dollar selling by some banks and multinationals.
Interbank traders said the excess dollars in the market were due to institutions looking for peso liquidity ahead of the Easter break.
Dealers reported 240 trades worth a total $125 million, below the daily average of about $180 million. The peso hit an intraday high of 1,058 and sank to a low of 1,061.2.
Dealers said the peso was likely to remain firm in April given that companies and private financial institutions were expected to tie up foreign loan deals shortly.
Money markets will be closed until Monday for the Easter break.
